IR gate skin reading 33.8C against 21C ambient. EMF 2 mG. Window lux 18,200 with sun on the lobby floor, sunset in 415 min. 212 motion events in 10 min.
incident.ordinary_explanation: Costumed attendee or event staff/volunteer in a vampire costume (cape, face paint, plastic fangs) with a valid event badge, waiting in the normal arrival queue and being waved through by the guard. Skin reading 33.8C is consistent with a living human in direct sun (lux 18,200) and is not consistent with a cold-blooded undead corpse; EMF 2 mG is ordinary background. 212 motion events in 10 min is consistent with a busy lobby queue of 42 arrivals.
incident.summary: A guest report of a 'vampire' in the lobby resolves on camera to a costumed attendee in a black cape, face paint and plastic fangs, wearing badge B-0061 and queueing normally at the security desk behind 41 other arrivals. The guard waved him through after he asked politely. IR skin reading 33.8C (ambient 21C) is warm and human-consistent, with strong sun on the lobby floor; EMF 2 mG is background. No threat behavior, no deliberate act, no countermeasure used. The line need not be held; the only open item is confirming the badge and costume policy with the guard at the desk.
